title: Cycle-Orbit Classification of Pullback-Fixed Equivalences

theorem.statement: For a finite permutation with cycle lengths m_i, invariant equivalences are classified by a partition of the cycle-index set, a common divisor d of the cycle lengths within each connected component, and relative phases modulo d.
theorem.count_formula: sum over set partitions S of {1,...,r} of product over components S of sum_{d | gcd(m_i : i in S)} d^(|S|-1)

core_reduction.statement: For finite T:X->X, pullback-fixed equivalences on X are in lattice isomorphism with invariant equivalences of the eventual periodic permutation core P=Per(T).

not_claimed: discovery of congruence lattices of unary algebras
universal classification of all unary algebra congruence lattices
claimed_scope: explicit cycle-length and phase counting formula
